items.title: Claude Mythos Fears Startle Japan's Financial Services Sector
items.description: Global financial institutions are panicked over Anthropic's new superhacker AI model. Cyber experts aren't quite as worried.

items.title: ZDI-CAN-29459: GIMP
items.description: A CVSS score 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H severity vulnerability discovered by '@pacbypass' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2026-04-29, 0 days ago. The vendor is given until 2026-08-27 to publish a fix or workaround. Once the vendor has created and tested a patch we will coordinate the release of a public advisory.
